messages.content: Who has the highest number of hearts in a game of poker?

message.content:
In a standard poker game the “highest number of hearts” a single player can hold is simply the maximum number of cards that make up that player’s hand.  
So the answer depends on the variant:

| Poker variant | Cards per player | Max hearts a player can hold |
|---------------|------------------|------------------------------|
| Five‑Card Draw | 5 | 5 hearts |
| Seven‑Card Stud | 7 | 7 hearts |
| Texas Hold’em (including community cards) | 7 (2 hole + 5 community) | 7 hearts |

**So in Texas Hold’em, the theoretical maximum is 7 hearts.**  
(If you’re only counting the two hole cards, the maximum is 2 hearts, but when you include the community cards a player can end up with all 7 cards as hearts.)
